claims.claim_text: On June 3, 2025, Kratos and GE Aerospace announced a formal teaming agreement to advance the development and production of engines for the next generation of affordable unmanned aerial systems and Collaborative Combat Aircraft-type (CCA-type) aircraft. Through Dec 28, 2025 Kratos recorded $31.5M revenue and $31.9M cost on the program; $12.9M revenue / $13.3M cost in FY2025 alone.

claims.object_value: $356.3M aggregate consideration, all-cash from balance sheet
claims.source_quote: On November 4, 2025, the Company and certain of its subsidiaries entered into a definitive merger agreement ... to acquire Orbit Technologies Ltd. ... The aggregate consideration payable by the Company pursuant to the Orbit Merger Agreement is expected to be approximately $ 356.3 million, which is expected to be funded via cash on the Company s balance sheet immediately prior to closing.

claims.claim_text: On February 20, 2026, Kratos entered into the 2026 Credit Agreement with PNC Bank (administrative agent) establishing a five-year senior secured $300M revolving credit facility (with $35M swingline and $50M LOC sub-facilities, plus uncommitted incremental of up to $135M). The 2022 Credit Agreement (which had $200M Term Loan A + $200M revolver) was terminated.
